Violent Clashes Erupt in South African Cities Over Immigration

Protests against immigration have turned violent in Johannesburg and Durban, South Africa. The protests began with demands for the deportation of undocumented foreigners, who were given a deadline to leave by June 30. The clashes resulted in injuries and property damage. The situation remains tense as authorities try to maintain order.
